author: Baron Godfrey Rathbone Benson Charnwood
claims: Abraham Lincoln attended the theatre on the night of Good Friday.
A shot was heard in the theatre sometime after 10 o'clock.
Abraham Lincoln fell forward upon the front of the box unconscious and dying.
The assassin was John Wilkes Booth, brother of a famous actor.
Abraham Lincoln was carried still unconscious to a house near the theatre.
Abraham Lincoln died on April 15 at 7:22 AM, as stated by Stanton.
Stanton's final words about Lincoln were, "Now he belongs to the ages."
